name: Tooru
source:
Lyrica's boyfriend who lives with her. Tooru is her de facto pimp, a former host and part-time worker. His looks are ok, but he is a womanizer with an unpleasant demeanor. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050209080853/http://www.aquarium-soft.com/aquarium/iyashite/char.htm]Official Website[/url].]
